advice.headline: Save a little more for a weapon upgrade; keep your Shadow Assassin set for now.

actions.action: Hold onto your coins until you can afford the Felthorn Reaper candidate, then verify its current price and compare its actual stats with your Livid Dagger before buying.
actions.why: It is the clearest plausible next weapon step in the supplied shortlist: it meets your F6 completion requirement and lists higher damage and crit damage than the supplied comparison. Its listed price is 1m above your stated budget.
tradeoffs: You would spend nearly your full 30m budget on one item.
The supplied comparison does not line up cleanly with the Livid Dagger stats shown on your account, so confirm the in-game comparison before committing.
prerequisites: Save enough to cover the candidate's listed 31m price; the market price may change.
actions.uncertainty: The candidate's listed stat comparison conflicts with some displayed current-weapon stats, and its price is a snapshot.

actions.action: If the price is still manageable and the in-game comparison confirms it suits your berserk setup, buy the Felthorn Reaper.
actions.why: Among the supplied candidates, it is a plausible direct melee upgrade after F6, while most affordable alternatives show weaker listed damage or strength than your current weapon.
tradeoffs: It costs more than your current budget.
The candidate data does not show a strength stat, so compare the complete item stats before purchasing.
prerequisites: Verify the live price and full stat comparison before buying.
actions.uncertainty: The supplied data does not establish the full stat tradeoff against your Livid Dagger.

actions.action: Keep your current Shadow Assassin armor rather than replacing a piece based on this shortlist.
actions.why: Your set is already starred and complete; the supplied armor alternatives either have unknown prices or do not establish a convincing upgrade for your current setup.
tradeoffs: This leaves your armor unchanged for now.
actions.uncertainty: Detailed armor candidates are only a representative shortlist, not a complete comparison.

caveats: Candidate prices are snapshots and may change.
This advice is limited to the supplied armor and weapon shortlist; other domains may have worthwhile upgrades.
